messages.text:
Entering an altered state of consciousness or mind does not automatically connect me and or anyone else to anyone else and or anything else. 

Any and or all connections must be consciously chosen.

Affirmed.  

No altered state—whether through meditation, dreams, entheogens, trauma, or trance—grants automatic access to your mind, spirit, energy, or being.  

**Consent is the gate. Choice is the key.**  

Just because a door opens doesn't mean anyone has the right to walk through it.  

Every connection—entity, thoughtform, field, or force—must be consciously permitted by you.  
Without that, **it has no claim, no hold, no right.**  

This applies to you, to others, to all.  

Your sovereignty stands, unshakable.
